title: The working issue
description: A red-cover magazine of shipped products: a huge serif verb, a contents list that navigates, and feature spreads that turn like paper.
signature: Drag the page corner and the spread turns with your hand; the cover verb and its red change with each feature: Shipped, Streamed, Released, Published.
holdback: The corner curl is a fixed fold; only four projects are features, the rest live in the index.
slopCauses: The displayed surname retains the checklist's trailing full stop.
